description: This file defines a PHP class ADODB_pdo_dblib which implements a database driver for the PDO extension targeting SQL Server or compatible databases, as part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It contains driver-specific SQL queries, methods for transaction management, schema introspection, and query execution.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_dblib
classes.description: A PHP class that extends ADODB_pdo to implement SQL Server/DB-LIB specific driver functionality, including schema queries, transaction management, and query execution.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction by calling the parent class method.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specified table, returning an array of field objects or associative array depending on fetch mode.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tables, optionally filtered by a pattern.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with an optional row limit and offset, modifying the query for top-based limits.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Prepares, binds parameters, executes an SQL statement, and handles errors.

methods.name: GetPDODataType
methods.description: Determines the PDO parameter type based on PHP variable type.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server information by calling the parent class method.
